Closed on main at 1c425ae (slices b6f3404, 3d941ca, 01f4daa, 9f8610d, de2d636 review fixes, e8bf74f slice 5, 1c425ae slice 5 review fixes). Plan docs/plans/2026-10-03-interaction-09-membership.md.
AC1: a bin selects exactly its members when exact membership is available (MemberSelectionSuite vs right-closed bucketing oracle over repeated/boundary values; browser: every bin in a 30-trial histogram, both scatters, SVG and Canvas); selecting the bin itself stays a distinct Target-mode selection (default).
AC2: counts/representatives/partial/stale never become selections (retain by StatInputPreservation: density Unavailable, Custom count-only; SelectMembers refuses non-Exact or stale; Complete replies must be exactly the counted, distinct, plot-scoped keys; every strict prefix rejected).
AC3: resolver outcomes Pending/Unavailable/Failed/Complete plus Rejected (malformed current) and Superseded (late/superseded/after domain change); request ids spent per target across replies and replaceDomain.
AC4: repeated equal rows and custom statistics: equal-row and Custom-contract fixtures; facets per panel; laws unchanged.
AC5: linked scatters and histogram show partial-selection counts (tooltip, companion, keyboard focus) and any/all/fraction emphasis (fraction at the exact half threshold in browser; any/all in MemberCoverageSuite); hovered observations ring their bin; filtering/recomputation is not offered (stated as Gap in docs/browser-capabilities.md).
Gates at 1c425ae: scalafmtCheckAll + testAll 16 targets / 2,183 tests; tools/check-compatibility.sh green (MembershipRetention.Deferred additive record; Breaking + MIGRATION entry); tools/check-browser-suites.py 13/13 jobs incl. membership (SVG+Canvas 8/8), paired widget/linked traces equal; tools/check-browser-consumer.sh 10/10 at 0.0.0-consumer-1c425aecd910. Fresh-context reviews after slices 1-4 and slice 5; all findings fixed or documented. Known limits: deferred plots treat every source observation as selectable (incl. undrawn rows); region sweeps skip deferred aggregates; a tooltip already open is not refreshed when a linked projection changes its coverage underneath.
